observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an engine block with multiple black plastic ignition coils, a yellow oil cap labeled 'ENGINE OIL', and various hoses and connectors. The engine appears to be in a workshop or garage setting.

Photo 1 shows the same engine from a slightly different angle, revealing the front of the engine with the alternator, pulleys, and timing belt. The engine block has visible casting marks and some wear.
No visible branding or model numbers are readable on the engine block or components in either photo.
The watermark 'EMMY GOLD AUTO SPARE' is present on both photos, suggesting a seller or reseller name.
